race.comment: CAPTIVATE ME (1) is in good form with top-five finishes at his last seven starts, most recently recording a second over 2190m at this track. No excuses from this advantageous draw and his recent form is good enough to take out a race like this. ALMIGHTY RUSH (3) is in good form at present. Finished fourth at her latest appearance over 1790m here, beaten 8 metres. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. Meets a comparable field and she can figure in the finish. SEASIDE LADY (7) is a great chance after a string of sound recent performances, the latest a solid second at Ballarat over 1710m. Hard to find fault. CRUEL MISTRESS (5) is in the mix following a respectable third at her most recent appearance over 2190m at this circuit. One for the multiples.
